trades.name: LBAF of 23370.5 Sunday night low holding 23342-23369
trades.quote: A LBAF of the 23370.5 Sunday night low that holds the 23342-23369 range is a long. It would need to reclaim 23425-23438 but if so it can be a powerful setup. Given the response we’ve now seen (twice) near that range and the significant potential for upside (200+ handles is completely reasonable), I’ll rate this as an A+. I would likely take profit at 425-438 unless it rips straight back through like it did last night, and be cautious if it rejects strongly, prepared to get flat if my entry is threatened.

trades.name: LAAF of 23552.5 Sunday night high
trades.quote: A LAAF of the 23552.5 Sunday night high is a short and I’ll rate it a B+/A-. This has potential to come from much higher, even the 575-600 range as Friday’s profile was pretty nasty. This would absolutely have to get through 23485-23499 to find any acceleration so I would be taking profit there and prepared to get flat (and maybe consider flipping long) if it holds.
